page_title: Bigjpg - AI Super-Resolution lossless image enlarging / upscaling tool using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

summary.name: Bigjpg
summary.one_liner: Bigjpg is a web-based AI image upscaler that uses deep convolutional neural networks to enlarge anime-style artwork and photos up to 16× without simple pixel stretching.
keywords: make image bigger without losing quality
summary.what_it_does: Bigjpg says it reconstructs lines, colors, and fine details when enlarging an image, rather than simply stretching pixels. It is aimed at artwork and photos, and it advertises enlargement up to 16x with less noise. The page describes a per-user quota system with plans that set a monthly image count and reset time. The free tier is listed with a shared server, slow speed, a 5MB upload limit, a 4x maximum ratio, and no parallel or batch mode. Paid tiers add faster servers, 50MB uploads, 16x enlargement, simultaneous enlarging, and history.
notable: Uses deep convolutional neural networks for super-resolution, aimed at anime-style artwork and photos
Enlarges images up to 16x; free tier capped at 4x
Monthly image quotas per plan with quota reset times
Mobile apps on App Store and Google Play; accepts Apple Pay, Google Wallet and crypto payments
caveats: Free tier limited to 5MB uploads, 4x enlargement, slow shared server, and no batch or parallel enlarging
Paid plans required for 16x enlargement, 50MB uploads, and higher monthly quotas
